test_title: PYST 16: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 14 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Divesh starts from point D and runs 3 km towards south. He then takes a right turn and runs 4 km. He then takes a left turn and runs 3 km. He takes another left turn and runs 4 km. He takes a final right turn and runs 1 km to reach point E. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he run in order to reach point D again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless otherwise specified.)
solution:
Given : 

 
• Divesh starts from point D and runs 3 km towards south.
 
• He then takes a right turn and runs 4 km.
 
• He then takes a left turn and runs 3 km.
 
• He takes another left turn and runs 4 km.
 
• He takes a final right turn and runs 1 km to reach point E.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c940c755606e52865632d4bcbbee1035479c4603ccc5ec6fff476c0b2a7e66a.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
